title: Monday pass: restore crypto cash floor; refresh equity momentum (JPM out, XLK in)
observation: Equity tech megacap (AAPL+MSFT+NVDA) is 29.74% of equity NAV (cap 30%), so equity hard caps are clean after the Sep 24 book. Crypto cash is 19.55% of crypto NAV (min 20%), invested 80.45%, so the cash floor is still breached. Equity live P&L since 2026-09-20 book is +1.7232% vs SPY +1.2682% over the same window. Crypto live P&L is +2.3011% vs BTC +2.3215%. Screen ranks MSFT/META/AAPL/NVDA/XLE/XLK/AMZN/XLV as the equity top8; JPM drops out (was held). Crypto screen ranks LINK/AVAX/SOL/ETH ahead of BTC.
logic: Options considered: (1) hold both sleeves with no trades (equity caps already OK; accept crypto cash ~19.55%); (2) crypto-only cash-floor trim (sell enough invested to restore 20% cash, leave names unchanged); (3) full weekly momentum rebalance on both sleeves to allocate.py / crypto_allocate.py targets (crypto restores cash to 20% and rotates BTC->SOL; equity exits JPM, adds XLK, trims MSFT, adds NVDA/AMZN, small XLE/XLV trims; tech stays ~29.5%). Chose (3) as the Monday proposal: crypto still breaches the locked min-cash rule, SOL remains above BTC on 63d, and equity has a clear cohort change (JPM out / XLK in) while tech stays inside the 30% cap. Did not propose a method switch: live book is ~6 trading days; equity is ahead of SPY and crypto is roughly matching BTC.
why: Repair the only hard-cap breach (crypto cash), keep equity aligned with the current 63d momentum cohort Jordan already approved, and avoid a method change without multi-week attribution.
how_to_judge: Over the next four Monday marks: (a) crypto cash stays >=20%; (b) equity tech sleeve stays <=30% NAV; (c) equity vs SPY and crypto vs BTC total return and max drawdown versus a no-rebalance hold log; (d) if XLK / SOL underperform the names they replaced for two consecutive Mondays, revisit those swaps alone.
